note: Gujjar Home Class versions. kid / par = homeclass-kid.html KID_VER / homeclass.html PAR_VER, kidApk / parApk = APK versionCode. Every open page checks this every minute and updates itself. Add a news line (k kid|par|all, v = the new version of that kind) with every change, newest first.

news.t: 📱 The 4 top buttons (Refresh, Help, Settings, Parents) now fit in one line.
📦 App updates are now about half the size (3 MB instead of 6 MB).
🔊 Children's screen: tap your picture to hear what you practised (⏹ Stop any time). Changes now always save - no more "Saving…" that never ends.
🎨 Settings: picture and colour always shown, the chosen one marked. Summary says the grade, the time and the stars clearly, and wishes a happy birthday on the day.

🏡 Parents: your family name on top - tap it (or a child's photo) to hear what each child practised; 📋 Today card; it also speaks when you open the app or press 🔄 (switch in ⚙️ Settings), never during a phone call, ⏹ Stop any time.
🔐 A Permissions card shows only when something is not allowed - tap the ❌ line to fix it.
📣 Call and 🙈 Test now always reach the child's own class phone.
👨‍👩‍👧 A parent's phone now opens straight into the parent screens (🧒 Kids at the top still shows the children's screen).
🔐 Home Class asks all its permissions at the first start (microphone, notifications, open by itself, battery, install updates). A new phone that joined with the family code now gets in straight away.
✅ Tables: when the child says "sixty" and the phone hears "sixteen" (thirty / thirteen ... ninety / nineteen), it now counts as right.
📲 Home Class opens straight into the app - the old kids screen no longer flashes first.
📚 Tables now go up to 50 (Settings → child → Tables from / to).
📱 A phone that reinstalls Home Class now replaces its own old entry in the device list by itself - no more double phones.
🔒 ONE parent PIN for the whole family - every phone's 🔒 Parents opens with it; change it in parent ⚙️ Settings.
🔒 Parent ⚙️ Settings: set, change or remove this phone's parent PIN. 🔊 Hear the first one and 🎤 Speak to type now work in the Home Class app.
✏️ Lessons now show their kind everywhere: "✏️ Spelling · EVS" or "💬 Questions · EVS". Parents: 🧒 Kids button at the top goes back to the children's screen.
🔒 Parents button always at the top of the phone (first time: choose a PIN). Child form: 🔊 Hear it keeps what you typed, and Save shows in red what is missing.
👨‍👩‍👧 One phone at home? Kids phone → ⚙️ Settings → "This is also the parent's phone" → choose a PIN → 🔒 Parents opens the parent part.
✅ Moved to the new Home Class app? The old Parents app now says so and offers 🗑 Remove this old app (Android asks once - tap OK).
📲 Home Class is now ONE app for parents, children and the TV - everything you saved stays.
📲 Parents: move to the new Home Class app in 1 minute (the card on Home shows how) - your family and all progress stay.
✅ Tables: when your child says the right answer first and a little noise comes after it, it is now counted right (it was marked wrong).
🗣️ Saying a table line by line: if your child is still on the line before, the app waits and asks again instead of marking it wrong.
📲 App h29 installs by itself - it is ready for the coming one app (nothing changes today).
🔧 Getting ready for the next big update - nothing changes today.
ℹ️ Settings → About & rules: Privacy Policy, Terms, Help, and 🗑 delete my family and data.
📣 After a call you now see "✅ said ready" or "❌ missed". 🤝 Invite a family in Settings.
📱 A new phone now asks you first: Allow or Deny, here on your phone.
👧👦 Each kids phone now shows its own child. Fixed: a change in the parent app could remove a child that was just added on a kids phone.

👋 A new kids phone now shows ONE screen: pick your name or ➕ New child, fill in name, class, 👦 boy / 👧 girl and 🎂 birthday (all needed), Save - ready. The phone is named after the child by itself. ⚙️ Settings shows every child's details directly.
📲 The family code is big on Home until your first child is added; after that it is a small line under Kids devices (more phones: ⚙️ Settings → Devices).
🔢 The top bar shows both versions: the screen (v..) and the Android app (h.. / p..).
📱 The child's "Class phone" list now shows your kids phones, and the device list updates by itself again. 🎂 A date of birth cannot be today or in the future.
🔢 The version shows next to "Home Class" at the top. 📲 The family code is always shown in ⚙️ Settings → Devices too - no button to press.
📲 Your family code is now permanent and always on the Home page - type it on any kids phone, TV or the other parent's phone. 🔁 New code if you ever need to change it.

🗣️ Saying a whole table is now line by line: each line lights up, say it, it turns green and the next one lights up - no button. A line not heard is asked again by voice at once. All lines heard = table learnt, no extra test.
👋 After linking, the kids phone asks once who learns on it - pick your name or add a new child, fill in the class and birthday, Save - all set. This phone then rings for that child's class.
✏️ Children's details moved to ⚙️ Settings - the home page shows only the class.

✏️ My details on the kids phone: name, class, 🎂 birthday and how the app says the name (🔊 Hear it) - with a Save button; Mom and Dad see it too. ⏸ Parents can turn all classes off with one tap. Answers are hands-free by default.
✨ Neater screens: the kids app top bar fits one line (family name and date under the title), and the device buttons in the parent app sit under the device details.
🔄 A refresh button (top bar) in both apps loads the newest version at once. ➕ Adding a child now works on every phone. The voice says "zaa" by default.
👨‍👩‍👧 Other families can use Home Class: start a new family with your family name, ➕ add your children, and 🆘 Report a problem (note + voice note) from Settings. Choose if voice clips may be saved.
🆘 Report a problem (top right): write or record what went wrong - it reaches the Home Class team with the log. The app now shows your family name.

app110.note: Which families / devices use the coming one app (homeclass-app.html) - needs kids app h29+. fams = first 22 chars of base64url SHA-256 of the family key (the pass server logs the same value). all:true = everyone.
